The Disk folder is checked on a schedule. A new file is matched by MD5.
Text is extracted from the file: docx, pdf or txt.
The text is cut into chunks, each with its own context. Then a second file appeared on the Disk.
An embedding is calculated for each chunk.
Everything is loaded into the vector database.
The second file goes the same way. A changed file gets updated, a deleted one disappears from the base.
The assistant answers from the content of the files.
